name: Yajima Hikaru
source:
The protagonist. The eldest son of the Yajima family, but he comes with the trifecta of a baby face, shyness, and cowardice. He's always getting scolded by his older sister, Makoto.

This time, Makoto's “Little Brother Strengthening Plan” has finally been activated, and things are about to get serious.

From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/authoringheaven/mkt/hikaru.html]official site[/url]]
